```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(
  {
  library(taxonomizr)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(stringr)
  library(rentrez)
  library(geneviewer)
  }
)

```

## Metascope/Pathoscope

### Method 1 (use accession numbers)

```{r}
## zgrep '^>' bacteria.fasta.gz >> "metascope_bacteria_raw.txt"

bacteria <- "metascope/metascope_bacteria_raw.txt"
fungi <- "metascope/metascope_fungi_raw.txt"
viral <- "metascope/metascope_viral_raw.txt"

line_bacteria <- readLines(bacteria)
line_fungi <- readLines(fungi)
line_viral <- readLines(viral)

all_lines <- c(line_bacteria, line_fungi, line_viral)

```

```{r}
accession_numbers <- as.vector(str_extract(all_lines, "(?<=^>)[^ ]+"))

taxid <- taxonomizr::accessionToTaxa(accession_numbers, sqlFile = "../../../../taxonomizr_db/accessionTaxa.sql")
```

```{r}
length(taxid)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(taxid))
```

### use batch entrez NCBI
```{r}
line_retry_taxid <- readLines("metascope/batch_process_na/results/metascope_na_NCBI.txt")
```
### total genomes for metascope
```{r}
total_taxid_metascope <- c(taxid, line_retry_taxid)
unique_taxid_metascope <- unique(total_genomes_metascope)
length(unique_taxid_metascope)
```





### Method 2 (column extraction)

```{r}
split_words <- strsplit(all_lines, " ")
names <- sapply(split_words, function(x) paste(x[2], x[3]))
unique_names <- unique(names)
```

```{r}
length(unique_names)
```

## Centrifuge

```{r}
centrifuge <- "centrifuge/centrifuge_raw.txt"
all_lines_centrifuge <- readLines(centrifuge)
line_with_accessions_centrifuge <- all_lines_centrifuge[1:8243]
split_centrifuge_accessions <- strsplit(line_with_accessions_centrifuge, split = " ")
centrifuge_accessions <- sapply(split_centrifuge_accessions, function(x) x[[1]])
```

```{r}
accessions_taxid_centrifuge_taxonomizr <- taxonomizr::accessionToTaxa(centrifuge_accessions, sqlFile = "../../../../taxonomizr_db/accessionTaxa.sql")
length(unique(accessions_taxid_centrifuge_taxonomizr))
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(accessions_taxid_centrifuge))
```

```{r}
na_position_accession <- which(is.na(accessions_taxid_centrifuge))
na_accession_centrifuge <- centrifuge_accession[na_position_accession]
```
### use batch entrez NCBI
```{r}
write.table(na_accession_centrifuge, file = "centrifuge/centrifuge_na_accession.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
lines_na_accession_centrifuge_ncbi <- readLines("centrifuge/results/centrifuge_success.txt")
```

```{r}
accession_taxid_centrifuge <- c(lines_na_accession_centrifuge_ncbi, accessions_taxid_centrifuge_taxonomizr)
unique_accession_taxid_centrifuge <- unique(accession_taxid_centrifuge)
length(unique_accession_taxid_centrifuge)
```


```{r}
result <- c()
for (i in seq_along(na_accession_centrifuge)) {
  current_accession <- na_accession_centrifuge[i]
  message("Processing ", current_accession, " (", i, " out of ", length(na_accession_centrifuge), " )")
  ncbi_id <- tryCatch(
    entrez_search(db = "nucleotide", term = current_accession)$ids, 
    error = function(e) 
      message(as.character(e$message), " for ", current_accession)
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)
  our_id <- entrez_link(dbfrom = "nuccore", id = ncbi_id, db = "all")$link$nuccore_nuccore_rsgb
  
  if (length(our_id) == 0 || is.null(our_id)) {
    message("No links found for ", current_accession)
    next
  }
  Sys.sleep(1)
  extract_taxid <- entrez_summary(db="nuccore", id=our_id) %>% extract_from_esummary("taxid")
  if (length(extract_taxid) == 0 || is.null(extract_taxid)) {
    message("No taxID found for ", current_accession)
    next
  } else {
    message("Found taxID for ", current_accession)
  }
  result <- c(result, extract_taxid)
  Sys.sleep(1)
}
```
